stage: answer to the 22:34 review: runtime defaults separated from editor policy, and the audition gate moved onto the raw registry findings

ai21.size_count: ToVector3 reads [0], [1] and [2], so fewer than three values is a runtime failure and is reported as one; more than three is accepted by the game because the extra values are ignored, and is now named as editor policy rather than an engine failure. The registry note says the same
ai21.explicit_null: an explicit null actor or bool behaves like an absent key in the runtime helper, so it is described as the default instead of being called a type error; a value of the wrong type still throws at the first qualifying entry and stays a problem

ai18.raw_gate: AuditionBlocked consults the registry's findings for the source id BEFORE the normalized view: a malformed raw value, a missing required field or an unknown field refuses the audition instead of being masked by the default the view had to substitute. The details panel uses the same single filter, so gate and text cannot drift
